producthunt.name: Fedica 2.0
producthunt.tagline: Publish and grow your profile across social apps
producthunt.description: For creators who want to succeed when their fans are fragmented across platforms. Know who engages, what they care about, and where they're from, with deep audience segmentation and demographics. Publish tailored posts on 12+ platforms. Connect with engagers from one inbox. 15 years of audience intelligence, built on Tweepsmap's geographic foundation. We put the people back in your analytics.

producthunt.name: Pushary
producthunt.tagline: Approve AI requests from your lock screen
producthunt.description: One command connects your AI agents to your lock screen. When Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Hermes, or Claude Cowork stops to ask, you tap yes from your phone and the run keeps moving. New in this launch: native iPhone and Android apps. Pairing is a QR code you scan from the terminal, no key to paste. Per-tool policies auto-approve the safe reads. Every decision lands in an audit trail.

producthunt.name: Kastra
producthunt.tagline: Runtime authorization for Claude, Cursor, Codex and OpenClaw
producthunt.description: Kastra is the runtime authorization layer for AI agents. It decides what agents can and cannot do before actions execute, enforcing policies with sub-1 ms latency across tools, prompts, inputs, and outputs. Use one control plane to govern agents and policies across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, the Anthropic SDK, the OpenAI SDK, and more. Prevent unauthorized tool use, prompt injection, and exposure of sensitive data before they become incidents. Trust the rules, not the agents.
